name: clean-eject
title: Clean Eject
description: Automatically remove macOS metadata files from removable storage devices before they are ejected.
author: capibawa

commands.name: index
commands.title: Select Device
commands.description: Choose a removable storage device (USB flash drive, SD card, or external drive) to clean up and eject.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
